sentences.text:
Counsel for Applicant :- Surya Prakash
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Subhash Vidyarthi,J.
1.

Heard Sri Surya Prakash, the learned counsel for the applicant as well as Sri Jayant Singh Tomar,
the learned Additional Government Advocate appearing on behalf of the State and perused the records.

2. The instant application has been filed by the applicant seeking anticipatory bail in F.I.R. bearing Case Crime No. 14 of 2020, under Sections 363, 366, 376 IPC & 3/4 POCSO Act, Police Station Khaurahra, District Lakhimpur Kheri.
3. The aforesaid case has been registered on the basis of an F.I.R. lodged on 19.01.2020 alleging that the applicant had enticed away the informant's daughter on 06.01.2020.
4. In the statement recorded under Sections 161 & 164 Cr.P.C, she stated her age to be 18 years and she stated that she loves the applicant,
She had gone away from her home out of her free will as her Suraj vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home ... on 19 October, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/98632499/

entities.text: Suraj vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 1 family members were not agreeing for their marriage.
She stated that she has married the applicant.
5. In the affidavit filed in support of the application it has been contended that the applicant is innocent, he has falsely been implicated in the present case and that he has no criminal history.
6. The learned A.G.A. has opposed the prayer for bail but he could not dispute the aforesaid aspects of the matter.

7. Having considered the aforesaid statement of the victim, I am of the view that the aforesaid facts are sufficient for making out a case for granting anticipatory bail to the applicant during pendency of the trial.
8. In view of the above, the anticipatory bail application of the applicant is allowed.

In the event of arrest/ appearance of applicant-Suraj before the learned Trial Court in the aforesaid case crime, he shall be released on anticipatory bail during pendency of the trial on his furnishing personal bond and two solvent sureties, each in the like amount, to the satisfaction of S.H.O./Court concerned on the following conditions and subject to any other conditions that may be fixed by the Trial Court:
(i). That the applicant shall appear before the trial court on each date fixed, unless personal presence is exempted;
(ii). That the applicant shall not, directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the court or to any police officer or tamper with the evidence;
(iii). That the applicant shall not pressurize/ intimidate the prosecution witness.
Order Date :- 19.10.2023 Pradeep/-
